FIFA President Defends World Cup Amid Criticism in Open Letter

FIFA President Gianni Infantino published an open letter defending the World Cup against critics. He stated that critics overlooked the joy and togetherness experienced by millions of fans. Infantino accused critics of spreading hate. Separately, UEFA and UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham criticized FIFA's proposals for private investment in its competitions, including the World Cup.
